items.name: hall_r1
items.text: Room tone of a large empty stone palace hall: a soft airy hush with a faint distant murmur of voices far away and the gentle crackle of a brazier. Smooth, even and continuous from start to finish. Mid-range, not bassy. No ticking, no clock, no clicks, no footsteps, no music.

items.name: drone_r1
items.text: A low tense sustained hum, like a large bronze singing bowl ringing softly: one steady mid-low tone with soft overtones, even from start to finish. Not a rumble, no sub-bass, no melody, no beat, no music.

items.name: cymbal_r1
items.text: Chinese opera percussion: one crash of a pair of large brass hand cymbals, a bright brassy metallic chang with a short shimmering ring. Brass, not glass. One crash only, no drum, no music.

items.name: cymbal_r2

items.name: cauldron_r1
items.text: A heavy bronze cauldron dropped onto a stone floor: a loud metallic clang and thud with a bright short ring, clearly audible in the mid and high range, not only bass. One impact only, no voices, no music.
